fields.description: The Alba Resort Residences is OMNIYAT’s furnished collection within its Palm Jumeirah beachfront destination. Zaha Hadid Architects designed the buildings, with landscaping by Vladimir Djurovic and services by Dorchester Collection. Two- and three-bedroom homes include simplex, double-height and duplex layouts.
